sections.label: Cabinet feet and sides
sections.evidence: Black bricks #0–15 form two feet beneath brown lower cabinet regions. Narrow brown strips at x=22 extend the right side upward through y=13.

sections.label: Cabinet and screen surround
sections.evidence: Brown additions fill the housing across x=1–23 and z=3–16, capped at y=14. Tan and black front strips surround the screen area; #914–916 form a top mount.

sections.label: Screen panel
sections.evidence: Light-gray bricks span x=4–17 at z=0–2 through y=5–12. White and red strips form the outer vertical bands of the front panel.

sections.label: Antenna stems
sections.evidence: Light-gray bricks #917–918 sit above the black top mount at y=16, z=9–11, forming paired stems at x=9 and x=14.

sections.label: Rear casing
sections.evidence: Dark-gray additions occupy z=16–20 and y=3–13, forming a broad rear housing with stepped side edges and a narrow top rim.

sections.label: Screen color bars
sections.evidence: Yellow, green and blue bricks create adjacent vertical bands across x=7–14, y=7–12 at z=0, with black strips beneath them.

sections.label: Antenna and exterior fittings
sections.evidence: Bricks #919–924 form outward-spreading light-gray antenna arms above the cabinet. Black and gray additions also occupy the front controls and rear tab at z=20.
